name: StarShard Scavengers
author: HitchH1k3r
description: Fly a spaceship, shoot asteroids and collect StarShards, then bring them to your station to score. Single-player is for practice. Warning: flashing colors.

descriptions.en: Fly a spaceship, shoot asteroids and collect StarShards, then bring them to your station to score. Single-player is for practice. Warning: flashing colors.
descriptions.it: Pilota un'astronave, spara agli asteroidi e raccogli StarShard da portare alla tua stazione per fare punti. In singolo è un allenamento. Attenzione: colori lampeggianti.
